ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon One Time Only Scheduled Task At 00:00
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects scheduled task creation events that include suspicious actions, and is run once at 00:00

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX(".*\\\\schtasks\\\.exe.*") OR process_original_file_name = "schtasks\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*wscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*vbscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wmic\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*wmic\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*regsvr32\\\.exe.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*once.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*00\\:00.*")))
